scenarios.headline: BREAKING: NASDAQ and S&P 500 Hit All-Time Highs
scenarios.detail: The NASDAQ Composite and S&P 500 both closed at record highs today, fueled by strong tech earnings and AI optimism. The Dow also gained. Analysts are watching whether the rally can hold into next week.

scenarios.headline: BREAKING: Major Tech CEO Announces Sudden Resignation
scenarios.detail: In a surprise announcement, the CEO of a Fortune 500 tech giant has resigned effective immediately. Board names interim chief. Stock halted in after-hours trading.

scenarios.headline: BREAKING: Historic Election Result Declared
scenarios.detail: After a night of dramatic vote counting, a historic result has been declared in the national election. Analysts calling it a turning point. Full analysis ahead.
